Good wine, good food, good value
Jul 2018 • Family
This wine bar and restaurant was one of the highlights of our trip to Saigon - so much so that we ate there two evenings running. The restaurant was around the corner from the Meridien where we were staying and on the first night was very quiet. The rest of the family group went to a neighbouring Vietnamese restaurant recommended by the hotel while my brother and I went to La Cave. It was a quiet night, we had the window table, and enjoyed the buy-one-get-one-free offer on the wine along with our steak and chips. There was no live music on the first night (instead we had some traditional background French music - Edith Piaf etc). The second night we came there was a live band (and more people) - we much preferred the first night! Our bill was only about $50......which included a very good Bordeaux and a second bottle to take away! Highly recommended.....particularly on a night without the band!

Smelly Lunch Food (saba fish) at La Cave Ngo Van Nam
Jul 2018 • Solo
I have just ordered the lunch set at La Cave Ngo Van Nam, Dist 1. The food I ordered for lunch was Saba fry fish with passion juice. I ate this same food several times in this restaurant but this time the smell of the fish was terrible, I tried one small peace of fish but it was uneatable and strong smell even the appearance of food color looked ok at first. I informed both waiter and waitress about the smell of the fish but they just look at and did not respond to change or did any actions. I stopped to eat fish after the first small one, just tried a piece of rice and vegestable. They still provided food to other customers and ignore my food (each time they passed my table, they felt shy). I normally enter this restaurant for lunch in a group of 2-6 people but today I came to this one alone.

After few minutes no response from restaurant, I finally asked for the bill, the waiter came, I reminded him one more time for the fish smell and he took the fish disk away, I thought he would come back and say something to me but no actions from him. The waistress gave the bill to me and I paid the bill 65,000vnd to her. The think here was that, their attitude was not acceptable, there was no word saying sorry or acting something to me. After paying the bill, i went out of the restaurant without any calls from restaurant. I would not recommend people to come and eat at this restaurant with this kind of bad attiude and customer support. So, you now know how they will supoort you if you are in my situation with bad food provided.

Expensive for below average food
Feb 2018 • Couples
I often pass in front of this restaurant while I stay at Le Meridien next door, so I decided to give it a go, mainly due to the live music and wine selection. 
Music was nice and the band was doing a good job despite singing in an empty restaurant (me and my girlfriend + a table of half drunk Japanese who didn't care much about the music). 
As my girlfriend doesn't drink much, I asked the waitress for wine by the glass as I couldn't see any on the menu .... apparently this wine restaurant doesn't offer the option to have a glass of wine and force you to buy a full bottle. 
I ordered a resonably priced bottle from the menu and of course few minutes later the waitress came back to tell me that it was not available and I had to order the next level up bottle. 
similarly when we ordered the food, it seemed that the low price option where not available, despite being there at 7pm, did they forgot to buy food for the day or simply have practice to force customers to buy higher priced items...
We ordered 2 starters and a main course and I clearly asked for the main course to came after the starters .... of course it all came together, and after eating the starters the fish was cold. 
Food was not much better than in a canteen. 
For a price tag of over VND 2 millions for 2, there are plenty of much better options in HCMC, to even bother considering this restaurant.

Wonderful small wine bar
Mar 2018 • Couples
We visited this small wine bar while just passing by on our way back to our hotel & we're so glad we did.
The numerous staff were immaculately dressed in black &were very friendly &attentive.
There was a very large selection of wines at very competitive ptrices. We chose an Italian white from Puglia &were each given a large glass to sample before we were given another full bottle. We also had another delicious Italian white as the bar was offering a 2for1 special deal.
There was also an excellent menu offering local & European dishes -we had a macaroni cheese with an unusual twist &a mushroom &shrimp fettuccine. Both were very tasty &good value.
Well worth a visit if you are in the area (we wished we'd discovered before our final night in HCMC!)

Wonderful Hang-out Spot
Jul 2017 • Friends
I went here with 3 friends to hang out after work. The menu is european, with pastas, steak etc. We had a cheese platter, and raw tuna dish for appetizers which was great, especially when paired with a Montgras Quatro Blanc wine and Mcguigan Semillion wine. 

Next, we shared an Australian steak and another duck dish(didn't get the name, but it was served with sliced oranges and mashed potato. This was paired with a Valpolicella Ripasso DOCG wine which was quite unique. Enjoyed the live band which started at 8pm, and we ended up requesting songs from Beatles, Beeges, Tom Sawyer which they could easily muster. Time flew by very fast.

Ambience is good for conversations even with the live band playing. Location is quite good, just on a small road behind Le Meridien Hotel along Ton Duc Thang Road. 

Will be back. A special shout-out to the French Manager and his team for their warm welcoming hospitality.
